events.title: Natural tractable frontier languages fail universal B2 interface requirements in distinct ways
results: Horn exact relations fail on constant-size XOR2 by meet closure.
Krom/2-CNF exact relations fail on constant-size odd PARITY3 by majority closure.
Affine GF(2) exact relations fail on constant-size OR2 by ternary-XOR closure.
OBDDs support useful exact operations in explicit representation size, but Hidden Weighted Bit has an external exponential OBDD lower bound while retaining polynomial ordinary/B2 circuit size.

provider_receipt.workflow: Validate Akinator RSPC Tractable Language Sweep

events.claim_ceiling: Does not rule out all tractable representation languages; OBDD lower bound is external and not a circuit lower bound.

events.title: Structured knowledge compilation does not provide a free universal exact B2 frontier
results: External IJCAI 2024 theorem: general structured d-DNNF is not polynomially closed under negation/disjunction/existential quantification, blocking free signed-B2 semantic updates.
For bounded-degree expander vertex-cover monotone 2-CNF, internal transfer gives linear ordinary/B2 encoding and linear graph treewidth.

External Amarilli-Monet-Senellart structured d-DNNF lower bound then yields exponential d-SDNNF size in the stated bounded-arity/bounded-degree treewidth scope; SDD inherits the lower bound as a structured deterministic subclass.

provider_receipt.workflow: Validate Akinator RSPC Structured KC Barrier

events.claim_ceiling: Knowledge-compilation barriers do not imply P!=NP and do not rule out interfaces weaker than full semantic model-set representations.

events.title: Complete root-clause proof interface has width-versus-frontier-size dichotomy
formal_statement: The complete width-w root Resolution frontier has exact universe size sum_{k<=w} 2^k binom(n,k).
For fixed w this is polynomially bounded and exact saturation is a tractable complete width-w interface.
Existing Ben-Sasson-Wigderson expander G-PHP width lower bounds show sufficiently low w cannot refute the frozen hard-family scope.
If w enters a linear hard-width regime, materializing the complete clause frontier requires 2^Omega(n) possible clauses.
This does not imply every sparse wide proof is exponential; it moves the next gate to sparse derivational discovery.

provider_receipt.workflow: Validate Akinator RSPC U1 Clause Frontier

events.claim_ceiling: Root Resolution width barrier is not an ER/B2 lower bound. Exponential complete frontier is not an exponential sparse-proof lower bound.

active_front.name: U1_B_SPARSE_DERIVATIONAL_INTERFACE
active_front.question: Can a deterministic polynomial Akinator maintain only a sparse polynomial number of proof objects and always discover a locally checkable, globally progressing B2 move without complete consequence saturation, semantic oracle calls, or exponential schema backtracking?

infer sparse-proof lower bound from complete-frontier size
